spec.query:
from(bucket: "london_air_raw")
  |> range(start: -24h, stop: 12h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "air_quality" and
    r.data_type == "forecast" and
    r.station_id == "148" and
    r._field == "pm10"
  )
  |> last()
